_comment: Verified placeholders that match the credential patterns in .github/scripts/validate.py. Each entry is an EXACT literal, not a pattern relaxation, so any credential that is not listed here still fails the build. Removing an entry from this file re-arms the check for that literal. Additions require manual verification that the string is non-functional, plus a note of how it was verified.

entries.label: AWS access key id
entries.reason: The canonical example key published in AWS's own IAM documentation. AWS states it is not a valid key. Appears only in a Terraform secret-scanner test fixture, a redaction checklist, and that checklist's linter test fixture.
entries.verified: Compared against the documented AWS example key; contains the literal substring 'EXAMPLE', which AWS reserves for documentation.

entries.label: GitHub personal access token
entries.reason: All-'a' placeholder in a redaction-linter test fixture that verifies the linter flags and redacts token-shaped strings.
entries.verified: Read in context: it is a string literal inside a unit test asserting the linter's detection behaviour. Not a credential.

entries.label: Anthropic API key
entries.reason: All-'a' placeholder inside a test message string used to prove the memory extractor detects credential-shaped content in conversation data.
entries.verified: Read in context: a dict literal in a test corpus. Repeated-character body cannot be a real key.

entries.label: PEM private key header
entries.reason: The header appears in three distinct non-credential roles: (1) a regex definition inside secret_scanner.py, where it is the pattern being searched for; (2) a test fixture asserting that a private-key header is detected; (3) a row in a redaction checklist describing what to redact. No key material follows the header in any case.
entries.verified: Read each occurrence; none is followed by base64 key body. In secret_scanner.py the occurrence is inside an r'' regex literal.

entries.label: PEM private key header
entries.reason: Regex definition in secret_scanner.py — the pattern being searched for, not a key.
entries.verified: Read in context: inside an r'' regex literal in a pattern list.

entries.label: PEM private key header
entries.reason: Regex definition in secret_scanner.py — the pattern being searched for, not a key.
entries.verified: Read in context: inside an r'' regex literal in a pattern list.

entries.label: JWT
entries.reason: The unmodified example JWT from jwt.io, present in a test fixture asserting that the scorer detects hardcoded tokens. Its signature is the published demo value.
entries.verified: Header/claims match the long-standing jwt.io example token; no issuer-specific or environment-specific claim is present.
